_about: Cross-claims the layers standing check accepts (tests/layersStanding.test.ts): a layered row of <category> that <claimed_by>'s mapping also places by a SKU rule. Each group is recorded with its exact row count — a new group, a grown or shrunk count, or a stale entry fails the check. Statuses: claimant-rule-too-broad (fix in that category's round), decided-home (a decision placed the family here), pending-round (the home is decided in the named round).
